name: Mentasm riff
desc: Second Phase-style mentasm lead: detuned supersaw stabs riffing in F minor with the signature hpf sweep climbing over 32 cycles, dub-delay space when sparse, 16th frenzy at peak.

code.full: note("[f3 f3 <ab3 c4> f3 ~ f3 <g3 eb4> ~]").add(note(${root})).s("supersaw").detune(${det}).penv(${dive}).pdec(.1).decay(.3).sustain(.15).hpf(sine.range(${lift}*.4, ${lift}).slow(32)).lpf(4500).shape(.2).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.25).every(8, rev).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("[f3 f3 ab3 f3 c4 f3 <eb4 db4> <c4 g3>]*2").add(note(${root})).s("supersaw").detune(${det}).penv(${dive}).pdec(.07).decay(.2).sustain(.1).hpf(sine.range(${lift}*.5, ${lift}*1.4).slow(8)).lpf(5000).shape(.25).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.2).every(4, x=>x.add(note(12))).orbit(5).play()
